Each brick is identified by a Space-Filling Curve (SFC) index.

**LOD Selection:** For the requested voxel at time step $\gamma$, identify the finest available LOD level.
**Address Calculation:** Calculate the offset in the BFAT using the time step ($\gamma$) on the Y-axis and the selected LOD on the X-axis.
